+    @cute.jit
+    def router(self, p: MoeParams, s: MoeState, gammas):
+        tid, warp, lane = s.tid, s.warp, s.lane
+        scratch = s.scratch
+        squares_r = cute.make_rmem_tensor(4, Float32)
+        sums01 = (Float32(0.0), Float32(0.0))
+        sums23 = (Float32(0.0), Float32(0.0))
+        muls = []
+        for g_r in cutlass.range_constexpr(3):
+            nw = []
+            for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                nw.append(
+                    rt.Convert.ld_bf16x8_words(
+                        s.norm_words, cdiv(g_r * 2048 + t * NORM_ROW + tid * 8, 2)
+                    )
+                )
+            for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+                gk = (gammas[g_r][k], gammas[g_r][k])
+                a = (nw[0][k], nw[1][k])
+                b = (nw[2][k], nw[3][k])
+                sums01 = rt.FastMath.fma2(a, a, sums01)
+                sums23 = rt.FastMath.fma2(b, b, sums23)
+                muls.append(rt.FastMath.mul2(a, gk))
+                muls.append(rt.FastMath.mul2(b, gk))
+        squares_r[0], squares_r[1] = sums01
+        squares_r[2], squares_r[3] = sums23
+        last_r = rt.Reduce.fold([squares_r[t] for t in range(4)], lane, 16, (4, 2, 1))
+        if (lane & 7) == 0:
+            scratch[(lane >> 3 & 3) * 8 + warp] = last_r
+        rt.mbar_wait(s.ring_full, 0)
+        acc = cute.make_rmem_tensor(8, Float32)
+        fused = [(Float32(0.0), Float32(0.0))] * 4
+        for g_r in cutlass.range_constexpr(3):
+            column = g_r * 2048 + tid * 8
+            r0 = rt.Convert.ld_bf16x8_words(s.ring_words, cdiv(column, 2))
+            r1 = rt.Convert.ld_bf16x8_words(s.ring_words, cdiv(rt.HIDDEN + column, 2))
+            for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+                pk = (r0[k], r0[k])
+                qk = (r1[k], r1[k])
+                for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                    fused[j] = rt.FastMath.fma2(
+                        muls[g_r * 16 + 2 * k + j // 2], (pk, qk)[j % 2], fused[j]
+                    )
+        for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+            acc[j % 2 + 4 * (j // 2)], acc[j % 2 + 2 + 4 * (j // 2)] = fused[j]
+        s.pages.release(0)
+        last_0 = rt.Reduce.fold([acc[i] for i in range(8)], lane, 16, (2, 1))
+        if (lane & 3) == 0:
+            scratch[64 + warp * 2 * 4 + (lane >> 2 & 7)] = last_0
+        rt.bar_sync(8, 256)
+        rt.bar_sync(11, 384)
+        fused_epoch = s.epoch_slot[0]
+        if tid < 8:
+            row_total = rt.Reduce.strided_sum(scratch, cdiv(tid, 2) * 8, 1)
+            inverse = rt.Reduce.rms_inverse(row_total)
+            total_r = rt.Reduce.strided_sum(scratch, 64 + tid, 8)
+            logit_0 = rt.mul(total_r, inverse)
+            self.publish_logit(p, s, logit_0, fused_epoch)
+        epoch = s.epoch_slot[0]
+        if tid == 0:
+            self.count_router_slice(p, s)
+        inverses_r = Rms.inverses(scratch)
+        for token_r in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+            for g_r in cutlass.range_constexpr(3):
+                off = token_r * NORM_ROW + g_r * 2048 + tid * 8
+                norm_dst = s.norm_addr + off * 2
+                words = rt.Convert.ld_bf16x8_words(s.norm_words, cdiv(off, 2))
+                Rms.store(norm_dst, words, inverses_r[token_r], gammas[g_r])
+        rt.bar_sync(11, 384)
+        return epoch
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def route(self, p: MoeParams, s: MoeState, early_bias):
+        lane = s.lane
+        self.score_and_route(p, s, early_bias)
+        if s.warp == 0:
+            expert = s.route_ids[lane]
+            cute.arch.atomic_min(s.first_lane.iterator + expert, lane)
+            cute.arch.sync_warp()
+            first = s.first_lane[expert]
+            _vote_0 = Uint32(cute.arch.vote_ballot_sync(first == lane))
+            below = (Uint32(1) << Uint32(first)) - 1
+            index = Int32(cute.arch.popc(_vote_0 & below))
+            if first == lane:
+                s.union_ids[index] = expert
+            s.union_route[index * 4 + cdiv(lane, 8)] = s.route_weights[lane]
+            cute.arch.sync_warp()
+            if lane == 0:
+                count_0 = Int32(cute.arch.popc(_vote_0))
+                s.union_count[0] = count_0
+                rt.mbar_arrive(s.union_full)
+        rt.bar_sync(8, 256)
+        count = s.union_count[0]
+        rounds = cdiv(count - cdiv(s.bid, 16) + 8 - 1, 8)
+        return count, rounds
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def down(self, p: MoeParams, s: MoeState, count, rounds):
+        bid, lane, warp = s.bid, s.lane, s.warp
+        total_r = rt.zeros(12)
+        rt.mbar_wait(s.planes_full, 0)
+        rt.mbar_wait(s.shared_down_full, 0)
+        down_off = DownPlane.pad(s.ring_u64_addr, self.SHARED_DOWN) + self.SHARED_DOWN
+        shared_rows = DownPlane.rows(s.ring_u64, down_off, warp, lane)
+        shared_scales = [
+            s.ring_f32[
+                DownPlane.scale_word(down_off + DownPlane.RECORD >> 2, bid, warp, k)
+            ]
+            for k in range(3)
+        ]
+        token_words = cmod(cdiv(lane, 4), 4) * ActPlane.ROW_WORDS + DownPlane.k_words(
+            warp, lane
+        )
+        shared_part = rt.zeros(12)
+        for kk in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+            b = rt.Memory.lds_weak_b64(
+                s.act_words_addr + (12672 + token_words + 4 * kk) * 4
+            )
+            for m in cutlass.range_constexpr(3):
+                acc_tile = cute.local_tile(shared_part, (4,), (m,))
+                frag = rt.Convert.a_frag_u64(
+                    shared_rows[2 * m], shared_rows[2 * m + 1], kk
+                )
+                rt.TensorCore.mma_acc(acc_tile, frag, b, False)
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(12):
+            total_r[i] = rt.fma(shared_part[i], shared_scales[cdiv(i, 4)], total_r[i])
+        self.routed_down(s, total_r, count, 1 + 6 * rounds)
+        return total_r

+    @cute.jit
+    def admit_down_page(self, s: MoeState, page):

+    def down_plane_word(self, expert):

+    def down_lane_words(self, warp, lane):

+    @cute.jit

+    @cute.jit
+    def load_cta(self, p: MoeParams, s: MoeState, epoch_ld, lane_0):
+        bid = s.bid

+    @cute.jit
+    def load_rounds(
+        self, p: MoeParams, s: MoeState, epoch_ld, lane_0, polled, count_ld, rounds_ld
+    ):
+        bid, warp, Flags = s.bid, s.warp, p.Flags
+        first_down_ld = 1 + 6 * rounds_ld
+        down_pages = cdiv(count_ld + 1, 2)
+        early_pages = cutlass.min(down_pages, 4)
+        loader_warp = warp - 8
+        if loader_warp == 0:
+            for page_ld in range(0, early_pages):
+                self.routed_down_page(
+                    p, s, first_down_ld + page_ld, page_ld, count_ld, s.union_ids
+                )
+            with rt.warp_leader(warp, 8):
+                rt.mbar_arrive(s.rows_free)
+            for page_ld in range(early_pages, down_pages):
+                self.routed_down_page(
+                    p, s, first_down_ld + page_ld, page_ld, count_ld, s.union_ids
+                )
+            if lane_0 < 8:
+                self.clear_stale_logits(Flags, epoch_ld, bid, lane_0, 0)
+        else:
+            if loader_warp == 3:
+                for published in range(0, rounds_ld):
+                    rt.mbar_wait(s.round_done + published * 8, 0)
+                    with rt.warp_leader(warp, 11):
+                        rt.Memory.fence_release_gpu()
+                        bump = Uint32(1)
+                        if published == rounds_ld - 1:
+                            bump = Uint32(5 - rounds_ld)
+                        base_ld = self.Flag.PAD_FIRST + (self.Flag.PAD_ROUND + bid)
+                        cute.arch.atomic_add(Flags.iterator + base_ld, bump)
+                        cute.arch.atomic_add(
+                            Flags.iterator + (base_ld + self.Flag.MIRROR), bump
+                        )
+                        cute.arch.atomic_add(
+                            Flags.iterator + (self.Flag.ROUND + bid), bump
+                        )
+                        if published == rounds_ld - 1:
+                            cute.arch.atomic_add(
+                                Flags.iterator + (self.Flag.ACT + bid), Uint32(1)
+                            )
+            lane_w = cmod(lane_0, 32)
+            union_rounds = cdiv(count_ld + 8 - 1, 8)
+            first_round = loader_warp
+            if loader_warp == 1:
+                first_round = 0
+            for round_index_ld in range(
+                first_round, cutlass.min(loader_warp + 1, union_rounds)
+            ):
+                if round_index_ld > 0:
+                    rt.mbar_wait(s.rows_free, 0)
+                target = epoch_ld * 4 + Uint32(round_index_ld) + 1
+                done_poll = Int32(0)
+                while done_poll == 0:
+                    satisfied = Int32(1)
+                    for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                        cta = lane_w + 32 * k
+                        seen = rt.Memory.ld_relaxed_gpu(
+                            rt.ga(Flags, polled + self.Flag.PAD_ROUND + cta)
+                        )
+                        if count_ld > cdiv(cta, 16) + 8 * round_index_ld:
+                            satisfied = satisfied & Int32(Int32(seen - target) >= 0)
+                    shared_seen = Uint32(epoch_ld + 1)
+                    if (round_index_ld == 0) & (lane_w < 16):
+                        shared_seen = rt.Memory.ld_relaxed_gpu(
+                            rt.ga(Flags, polled + self.Flag.PAD_SHARED + lane_w)
+                        )
+                    satisfied = satisfied & Int32(
+                        Int32(shared_seen - (epoch_ld + 1)) >= 0
+                    )
+                    done_poll = Int32(cute.arch.vote_all_sync(satisfied != 0))
+                rt.Memory.fence_acquire_gpu()
+                cute.arch.sync_warp()
+                for group in range(0, cutlass.min(count_ld - 8 * round_index_ld, 8)):
+                    plane = 1 + group + 8 * round_index_ld
+                    for part_ld in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                        chunk = plane * 128 + lane_w + 32 * part_ld
+                        rt.AsyncCopy.cp_async_cg16(
+                            s.act_words_addr
+                            + (
+                                (plane - 9 + 33 * Int32(plane < 9)) * 4
+                                + cmod(cdiv(chunk, 32), 4)
+                            )
+                            * ActPlane.ROW_BYTES
+                            + cmod(chunk, 32) * 16,
+                            rt.ga(p.Activation, chunk * 8),
+                        )
+                if round_index_ld == 0:
+                    for part_ld in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                        chunk = lane_w + 32 * part_ld
+                        rt.AsyncCopy.cp_async_cg16(
+                            s.act_words_addr
+                            + (96 + cmod(cdiv(chunk, 32), 4)) * ActPlane.ROW_BYTES
+                            + cmod(chunk, 32) * 16,
+                            rt.ga(p.Activation, chunk * 8),
+                        )
+                cute.arch.cp_async_commit_group()
+                cute.arch.cp_async_wait_group(0)
+                rt.mbar_arrive(s.planes_full + round_index_ld * 8)
+                if (round_index_ld == union_rounds - 1) & (lane_w == 0):
+                    cute.arch.atomic_add(
+                        Flags.iterator + (self.Flag.PLANES + bid), Uint32(1)
+                    )
+            if (lane_0 >= 32) & (lane_0 < 40):
+                self.clear_stale_logits(Flags, epoch_ld, bid, lane_0 - 32, 1)

+        for part in cutlass.range_constexpr(3):

+                first = (words[0][k], words[1][k])
+                second = (words[2][k], words[3][k])
+                sums01 = rt.FastMath.fma2(first, first, sums01)
+                sums23 = rt.FastMath.fma2(second, second, sums23)
+                muls.append(rt.FastMath.mul2(first, gamma))
+                muls.append(rt.FastMath.mul2(second, gamma))
+        squares = [sums01[0], sums01[1], sums23[0], sums23[1]]

+ROUTER_THIRD = ROUTER_ROW_BYTES // 3

+@cache
+def smem_layout(rmax: int) -> type[rt.SmemLayout]:
+    """The shared-memory map of the tier with row capacity ``rmax`` (one class per
+    tier).
+    """
+    sh = TierShape(rmax)
+    q = rmax
+    router_bytes = max(
+        ROUTER_EXPERTS * ROUTER_ROW_BYTES, 2 * ROUTER_ROW_BYTES + 2 * q * EXPERTS * 4
+    )
+    small = (
+        256 * 4
+        + 3 * q * TOP_K * 4
+        + 64
+        + q * 4
+        + 4096
+        + 320
+        + q * OWNER_ROWS * 2
+        + q * K_BLOCKS * 4
+        + 4096
+    )
+    avail = SMEM_BYTES - _align(small, 1024) - 1024
+    stages = min(MAX_STAGES, avail // sh.ring_stage)
+    down_stages = 4 if 2 * q * 5 <= 512 and 4 * sh.down_stage <= avail else 3
+    assert stages >= 4 and down_stages * sh.down_stage <= avail, (
+        rmax,
+        stages,
+        down_stages,
+    )
+    ring_bytes = max(stages * sh.ring_stage, down_stages * sh.down_stage, router_bytes)
+    assert ring_bytes <= avail, (rmax, ring_bytes, avail)
+    tmem_columns = 512 if 2 * q * (down_stages + 1) > 256 else 256
+
+    class W8A8Smem(rt.SmemLayout):
+        STAGES = stages
+        DOWN_STAGES = down_stages
+        TMEM_COLUMNS = tmem_columns
+        LOGITS = 2 * ROUTER_ROW_BYTES
+        CORRECTED = 2 * ROUTER_ROW_BYTES + q * EXPERTS * 4
+        a = rt.SmemAlloc(SMEM_BYTES)
+        ring_full = a.mbarriers(MAX_STAGES, arrivals=1)
+        ring_empty = a.mbarriers(MAX_STAGES, arrivals=1)
+        down_full = a.mbarriers(4, arrivals=1)
+        down_ready = a.mbarriers(4, arrivals=1)
+        down_free = a.mbarriers(4, arrivals=4)
+        acc_full = a.mbarriers(2, arrivals=1)
+        acc_empty = a.mbarriers(2, arrivals=4)
+        router_full = a.mbarriers(3, arrivals=1)
+        union_full = a.mbarriers(1, arrivals=1)
+        scores_full = a.mbarriers(1, arrivals=1)
+        scales_full = a.mbarriers(1, arrivals=1)
+        up_done = a.mbarriers(1, arrivals=1)
+        tmem_hold = a.array(Int32, 1)
+        epoch_slot = a.array(Uint32, 1)
+        union_count = a.array(Int32, 1)
+        first_pair = a.array(Int32, EXPERTS)
+        route_ids = a.array(Int32, q * TOP_K)
+        route_weights = a.array(Float32, q * TOP_K)
+        union_ids = a.array(Int32, sh.max_union)
+        owners = a.array(Uint32, 16)
+        inverse = a.array(Float32, q)
+        scratch = a.array(Float32, 1024)
+        fin_amax = a.array(Float32, 64)
+        fin_scale = a.array(Float32, 16)
+        local_o = a.array(BFloat16, q * OWNER_ROWS, also=(Uint32,))
+        token_scales = a.array(Float32, q * K_BLOCKS, align=16)
+        up_scales = a.array(Float32, 256)
+        ring = a.array(
+            Uint8,
+            ring_bytes,
+            align=1024,
+            also=(BFloat16, Uint64, Uint32, Float32),
+        )
+
+    return W8A8Smem

+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class W8A8State:

+class FusedMoeW8A8(MoeRouting, rt.UpDownMapKernel):
+    """The W8A8 row-tier MoE of the module docstring; ``RMAX`` is the tier's row
+    capacity.
+    """
+
+    RMAX = 16
+    #: The seam variant hands the next layer's shared worker ``Final x gamma`` as well.
+    SEAM = False
+    GRID = GRID_CTAS
+    Params = MoeW8A8Params
+    ROLES = (rt.Role("compute", 0, 7, 208, True), rt.Role("load", 8, 11, 80, False))
+    SMEM_BYTES = SMEM_BYTES
+
+    @property
+    def shape(self) -> TierShape:
+        return TierShape(self.RMAX, self.SEAM)
+
+    @property
+    def exchange(self) -> rt.SliceExchange:
+        return rt.SliceExchange(self.RMAX, self.SEAM)
+
+    @property
+    def Smem(self) -> type[rt.SmemLayout]:  # noqa: N802
+        return smem_layout(self.RMAX)
+
+    def mbarriers(self) -> tuple:
+        return self.Smem.barriers()
+
+    def smem(self, base):
+        return self.Smem.record(base, bases=(W8A8State,))
+
+    def tensor_maps(self, p) -> tuple:
+        w13, w2 = LAYOUT.w13_expert_bytes, LAYOUT.w2_expert_bytes
+        groups = [LAYOUT.routed_experts * size // (16 * K_BLOCK) for size in (w13, w2)]
+        return (
+            rt.byte_map(
+                p.RoutedUp.toint(),
+                [K_BLOCK, 2, 8, groups[0]],
+                [1024, K_BLOCK, 2048],
+                [K_BLOCK, 2, 8, SLICE // 16],
+                True,
+            ),
+            rt.byte_map(
+                p.RoutedDown.toint(),
+                [K_BLOCK, 2, 8, groups[1]],
+                [1024, K_BLOCK, 2048],
+                [K_BLOCK, 2, 8, DOWN_ROW_BLOCK // 16],
+                True,
+            ),
+            rt.byte_map(
+                p.SharedUp.toint(),
+                [HIDDEN, 2 * SHARD, 1, 1],
+                [HIDDEN, w13, w13],
+                [K_BLOCK, SLICE, 1, 1],
+                True,
+            ),
+            rt.byte_map(
+                p.SharedDown.toint(),
+                [SHARD, HIDDEN, 1, 1],
+                [SHARD, w2, w2],
+                [K_BLOCK, DOWN_ROW_BLOCK, 1, 1],
+                True,
+            ),
+        )
+
+    @cute.kernel
+    def kernel(
+        self,
+        p,
+        UpMap: rt.GridConstant[rt.TensorMap],
+        DownMap: rt.GridConstant[rt.TensorMap],
+        SharedUpMap: rt.GridConstant[rt.TensorMap],
+        SharedDownMap: rt.GridConstant[rt.TensorMap],
+    ):
+        self.up_map, self.down_map = UpMap.get_ptr().toint(), DownMap.get_ptr().toint()
+        self.shared_up_map = SharedUpMap.get_ptr().toint()
+        self.shared_down_map = SharedDownMap.get_ptr().toint()
+        ids, s = self.prologue(p)
+        self.run(p, s, ids)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def weight_box(self, maps, kb, row, expert, kblocks, rows):
+        shared = expert == LAYOUT.shared_slot
+        group = cdiv((expert * kblocks + kb) * rows + row, 16)
+        return (
+            cutlass.select_(shared, maps[1], maps[0]),
+            cutlass.select_(shared, Int32(kb) * K_BLOCK, 0),
+            cutlass.select_(shared, row, 0),
+            cutlass.select_(shared, 0, group),
+        )
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def run(self, p, s, ids: rt.ThreadIds) -> None:
+        sm = self.Smem
+        taddr = rt.Umma.alloc(s.base, sm.tmem_hold.offset, sm.TMEM_COLUMNS, ids.warp)
+        rt.RoleKernel.run(self, p, replace(s, taddr=taddr), ids)
+        cute.arch.sync_threads()
+        rt.Umma.free(s.base, sm.tmem_hold.offset, sm.TMEM_COLUMNS, ids.warp)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def signal(self, p, warp, index):
+        with rt.warp_leader(warp, 0):
+            rt.Memory.fence_release_gpu()
+            rt.Memory.atomic_add_u32(p.Flags, index, 1)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def compute(self, p: MoeW8A8Params, s: W8A8State, ids: rt.ThreadIds):
+        p, s = p.views(), _bind(s, ids)
+        tid, warp, bid = s.tid, s.warp, s.bid  # noqa: F841  unused here, kept with the other bindings
+        if bid < LOW_CTAS:
+            self.router_issue(p, s)
+        bias = p.CorrectionBias[self.router_column(s)]
+        self.set_regs("compute")
+        cute.arch.griddepcontrol_wait()
+        cute.arch.griddepcontrol_launch_dependents()
+        rows = self.active_rows(p)
+        if bid < LOW_CTAS:
+            self.front(p, s, rows, bias)
+            self.signal(p, s.warp, self.shape.flag_router + bid)
+        rt.bar_sync(11, THREADS)
+        if bid < LOW_CTAS:
+            self.publish_image(p, s, rows)
+            self.signal(p, s.warp, self.shape.flag_image + bid)
+        rt.mbar_wait(s.scores_full, 0)
+        self.select_and_union(p, s, rows)
+        self.compute_stages(p, s, rows, warp, bid)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def compute_stages(self, p, s, rows, warp, bid):
+        epoch = s.epoch_slot[0]
+        units = self.unit_count(s)
+        if warp < 4:
+            self.up_promote(p, s, units)
+            self.down_promote(p, s, rows)
+        else:
+            self.finalize(p, s, rows, epoch)
+        if bid < LOW_CTAS:
+            self.owner(p, s, rows, epoch)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def router_issue(self, p, s):
+        with rt.warp_leader(s.warp, 0):
+            cute.arch.griddepcontrol_wait()
+            policy = rt.AsyncCopy.createpolicy_evict_first(
+                rt.ga(p.RouterWeight, 0), 3145728, 3145728
+            )
+            first = cmod(s.bid, ROUTER_COLUMNS) * ROUTER_EXPERTS
+            for v in cutlass.range_constexpr(3):
+                rt.mbar_expect_tx(s.router_full + v * 8, ROUTER_EXPERTS * ROUTER_THIRD)
+                for e in cutlass.range_constexpr(ROUTER_EXPERTS):
+                    rt.bulk_g2s_hint(
+                        s.ring_addr + (v * ROUTER_EXPERTS + e) * ROUTER_THIRD,
+                        rt.ga(p.RouterWeight, (first + e) * HIDDEN + v * 2048),
+                        ROUTER_THIRD,
+                        s.router_full + v * 8,
+                        policy,
+                    )
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def router_column(self, s):
+        return cmod(s.bid, ROUTER_COLUMNS) * ROUTER_EXPERTS + cmod(
+            s.tid, ROUTER_EXPERTS
+        )
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def front(self, p, s, rows, bias):
+        rt.mbar_wait(s.router_full, 0)
+        gammas = self.router_gammas(p, s)
+        self.router_groups(p, s, rows, gammas, bias)
+        for v in cutlass.range_constexpr(1, 3):
+            rt.mbar_wait(s.router_full + v * 8, 0)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def publish_image(self, p, s, rows):
+        self.quantize_rows(p, s, rows)
+        rt.Memory.fence_proxy_async_global()
+        rt.bar_sync(8, 256)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def router_gammas(self, p, s):
+        gammas = []
+        for v in cutlass.range_constexpr(3):
+            gammas += rt.Convert.bf16x8_to_f32(
+                rt.Memory.ld_global_v4(rt.ga(p.Gamma, v * 2048 + s.tid * 8))
+            )
+        return gammas
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def router_groups(self, p, s, rows, gammas, bias):
+        slice_ = cdiv(s.bid, ROUTER_COLUMNS)
+        groups = cdiv(rows + ROUTER_GROUP - 1, ROUTER_GROUP)
+        for group in range(slice_, groups, ROUTER_SPLIT):
+            self.router_group(p, s, group, rows, gammas, bias)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def router_group(self, p, s, group, rows, gammas, bias):
+        tid, warp, lane = s.tid, s.warp, s.lane
+        first = group * ROUTER_GROUP
+        squares = [Float32(0.0) for _ in range(ROUTER_GROUP)]
+        logits = [
+            [Float32(0.0) for _ in range(ROUTER_EXPERTS)] for _ in range(ROUTER_GROUP)
+        ]
+        for v in cutlass.range_constexpr(3):
+            rt.mbar_wait(s.router_full + v * 8, 0)
+            scaled = []
+            for r in cutlass.range_constexpr(ROUTER_GROUP):
+                row = cutlass.min(first + r, rows - 1)
+                x = rt.Convert.bf16x8_to_f32(
+                    rt.Memory.ld_global_v4(
+                        rt.ga(p.X, row * HIDDEN + v * 2048 + tid * 8)
+                    )
+                )
+                values = []
+                for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+                    squares[r] = rt.fma(x[i], x[i], squares[r])
+                    values.append(rt.mul(x[i], gammas[v * 8 + i]))
+                scaled.append(values)
+            for e in cutlass.range_constexpr(ROUTER_EXPERTS):
+                w = rt.Convert.bf16x8_to_f32(
+                    rt.Memory.lds_v4(
+                        s.ring_addr + (v * ROUTER_EXPERTS + e) * ROUTER_THIRD + tid * 16
+                    )
+                )
+                for r in cutlass.range_constexpr(ROUTER_GROUP):
+                    acc = logits[r][e]
+                    for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+                        acc = rt.fma(scaled[r][i], w[i], acc)
+                    logits[r][e] = acc
+        flat = [x for per_row in logits for x in per_row]
+        # Lane ``l`` ends with row ``l // 8``, expert ``l % 8`` of the warp's partials.
+        s.scratch[warp * 32 + lane] = rt.Reduce.fold(flat, lane, 16, ())
+        total = rt.Reduce.fold(squares, lane, 16, (4, 2, 1))
+        if (lane & 7) == 0:
+            s.scratch[256 + warp * ROUTER_GROUP + cdiv(lane, 8)] = total
+        rt.bar_sync(8, 256)
+        if tid < 32:
+            row_in, expert = cdiv(tid, ROUTER_EXPERTS), cmod(tid, ROUTER_EXPERTS)
+            logit = rt.Reduce.strided_sum(s.scratch, tid, 32)
+            inverse = rt.Reduce.rms_inverse(
+                rt.Reduce.strided_sum(s.scratch, 256 + row_in, ROUTER_GROUP)
+            )
+            if first + row_in < rows:
+                at = (first + row_in) * EXPERTS + self.router_column(s)
+                value = rt.mul(logit, inverse)
+                score = rt.FastMath.rcp_rn(
+                    rt.add(1.0, cute.math.exp2(rt.mul(-value, LOG2E), fastmath=True))
+                )
+                biased = rt.add(score, bias)
+                finite = rt.FastMath.fcmp(">=", biased, -FLT_MAX) & rt.FastMath.fcmp(
+                    "<=", biased, FLT_MAX
+                )
+                p.RouterLogits[at] = value
+                p.Work[self.shape.scores // 4 + at] = rt.Convert.f32_bits(score)
+                if finite:
+                    p.Work[self.shape.corrected // 4 + at] = rt.Convert.f32_bits(biased)
+                else:
+                    p.Work[self.shape.corrected // 4 + at] = rt.Convert.f32_bits(
+                        Float32(-FLT_MAX)
+                    )
+            if expert == 0:
+                s.inverse[first + row_in] = inverse
+        rt.bar_sync(8, 256)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def quantize_rows(self, p, s, rows):
+        slice_, column = cdiv(s.bid, ROUTER_COLUMNS), cmod(s.bid, ROUTER_COLUMNS)
+        groups = cdiv(rows + ROUTER_GROUP - 1, ROUTER_GROUP)
+        mine = cdiv(groups - slice_ + ROUTER_SPLIT - 1, ROUTER_SPLIT)
+        first_job = column + ROUTER_COLUMNS * s.warp
+        for job in range(first_job, mine * K_BLOCKS, 8 * ROUTER_COLUMNS):
+            group = slice_ + ROUTER_SPLIT * cdiv(job, K_BLOCKS)
+            self.quantize_job(p, s, group * ROUTER_GROUP, cmod(job, K_BLOCKS))
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def quantize_job(self, p, s, first, kb):
+        sh = self.shape
+        q = self.RMAX
+        token = first + cdiv(s.lane, 8)
+        c8 = cmod(s.lane, 8)
+        column = kb * K_BLOCK + c8 * 16
+        inverse = s.inverse[token]
+        values = []
+        amax = Float32(0.0)
+        for half in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+            x = rt.Convert.bf16x8_to_f32(
+                rt.Memory.ld_global_v4(rt.ga(p.X, token * HIDDEN + column + half * 8))
+            )
+            g = rt.Convert.bf16x8_to_f32(
+                rt.Memory.ld_global_v4(rt.ga(p.Gamma, column + half * 8))
+            )
+            for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+                v = rt.Convert.bf16_round(rt.mul(rt.mul(x[i], inverse), g[i]))
+                values.append(v)
+                amax = rt.FastMath.fmax(amax, rt.FastMath.abs_ftz(v))
+        for bit in cutlass.range_constexpr(3):
+            amax = rt.FastMath.fmax(amax, cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(amax, 1 << bit))
+        scale = rt.FastMath.div_rn(rt.FastMath.fmax(amax, QUANT_EPS), FP8_MAX)
+        words = []
+        for w in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+            words.append(
+                rt.Convert.e4m3x4(
+                    *[rt.FastMath.div_rn(values[4 * w + i], scale) for i in range(4)]
+                )
+            )
+        row8 = cmod(token, 8)
+        byte = (
+            sh.image
+            + kb * q * K_BLOCK
+            + cdiv(token, 8) * 1024
+            + row8 * 128
+            + ((c8 ^ row8) * 16)
+        )
+        rt.Memory.stg_u32x4(p.Work, cdiv(byte, 4), words)
+        if c8 == 0:
+            p.Work[sh.image_scales // 4 + kb * q + token] = rt.Convert.f32_bits(scale)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def select_and_union(self, p, s, rows):
+        self.select_reset(p, s)
+        self.select_routes(p, s, rows)
+        self.select_union(p, s, rows)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def select_reset(self, p, s):
+        s.first_pair[s.tid] = BIG
+        if s.tid < 16:
+            s.owners[s.tid] = Uint32(0)
+        rt.bar_sync(8, 256)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def select_routes(self, p, s, rows):
+        sm = self.Smem
+        logits = rt.Memory.smem_view_n(
+            s.base, sm.ring.offset + sm.LOGITS, Float32, self.RMAX * EXPERTS
+        )
+        corrected = rt.Memory.smem_view_n(
+            s.base, sm.ring.offset + sm.CORRECTED, Float32, self.RMAX * EXPERTS
+        )
+        routes = (
+            corrected,
+            logits,
+            s.route_ids,
+            s.route_weights,
+            p.RouteIds,
+            p.RouteWeights,
+        )
+        mine = cdiv(rows + 7 - s.warp, 8)
+        for pair in range(cdiv(mine + 1, 2)):
+            first = s.warp + 16 * pair
+            second = first + 8
+            if second >= rows:
+                second = first

+    @cute.jit
+    def route_pair(self, routes, lane, bid, row_a, row_b):
+        corrected, scores, route_ids, route_weights, RouteIds, RouteWeights = routes
+        rows = (row_a, row_b)
+        reads = (row_a, row_b)
+        local = (
+            cute.make_rmem_tensor(8, Float32),
+            cute.make_rmem_tensor(8, Float32),
+        )
+        for r in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+            for item in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+                local[r][item] = corrected[reads[r] * EXPERTS + lane + 32 * item]
+        for slot in cutlass.range_constexpr(TOP_K):
+            best = []
+            for r in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                max_lo = rt.FastMath.max3(local[r][0], local[r][1], local[r][2])
+                max_mid = rt.FastMath.max3(local[r][3], local[r][4], local[r][5])
+                max_hi = rt.FastMath.fmax(local[r][6], local[r][7])
+                best.append(
+                    rt.Sync.redux_max_nan_f32(rt.FastMath.max3(max_lo, max_mid, max_hi))
+                )
+            owned = []
+            for r in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                mine = Uint32(4294967295)
+                for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+                    if rt.FastMath.fcmp("==", local[r][7 - j], best[r]):
+                        mine = Uint32(lane + 32 * (7 - j))
+                owned.append(mine)
+            for r in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                best_id = Int32(rt.Sync.redux_min_u32(owned[r]))
+                for item in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+                    if best_id == lane + 32 * item:
+                        local[r][item] = -float("inf")
+                if lane == 0:
+                    route_ids[rows[r] * 8 + slot] = best_id
+        cute.arch.sync_warp()
+        picked = []
+        for r in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+            route = rows[r] * 8 + cmod(lane, 8)
+            picked.append(scores[reads[r] * EXPERTS + route_ids[route]])
+        totals = []
+        for r in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+            selected = Float32(0.0)
+            if lane < 8:
+                selected = picked[r]
+            totals.append(rt.Reduce.fold([selected], lane, 16, (16, 8, 4, 2, 1)))
+        for r in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+            total = totals[r]
+            if rt.FastMath.fcmp("<=", total, 0.0):
+                total = Float32(1.0)
+            route = rows[r] * 8 + cmod(lane, 8)
+            weight = rt.FastMath.div_rn(rt.mul(picked[r], 2.5), total)
+            if lane < 8:
+                route_weights[route] = weight
+                if bid == 0:
+                    RouteIds[route] = route_ids[route]
+                    RouteWeights[route] = weight

+    @cute.jit
+    def select_union(self, p, s, rows):
+        tid, warp, lane = s.tid, s.warp, s.lane
+        sh = self.shape
+        pairs = TOP_K * rows
+        rounds = cdiv(pairs + 255, 256)
+        for k in range(rounds):
+            pair = tid + 256 * k
+            if pair < pairs:
+                cute.arch.atomic_min(s.first_pair.iterator + s.route_ids[pair], pair)
+        rt.bar_sync(8, 256)
+        below = (Uint32(1) << Uint32(lane)) - 1
+        for k in range(rounds):
+            pair = tid + 256 * k
+            safe = cutlass.min(pair, pairs - 1)
+            leader = (pair < pairs) & (s.first_pair[s.route_ids[safe]] == safe)
+            word = Uint32(cute.arch.vote_ballot_sync(leader))
+            if lane == 0:
+                s.owners[k * 8 + warp] = word
+        rt.bar_sync(8, 256)
+        total = Int32(0)
+        for w in cutlass.range_constexpr(16):
+            total = total + Int32(cute.arch.popc(s.owners[w]))
+        for k in range(rounds):
+            pair = tid + 256 * k
+            if pair < pairs:
+                expert = s.route_ids[pair]
+                if s.first_pair[expert] == pair:
+                    before = Int32(0)
+                    for w in cutlass.range_constexpr(16):
+                        if w < k * 8 + warp:
+                            before = before + Int32(cute.arch.popc(s.owners[w]))
+                    index = before + Int32(
+                        cute.arch.popc(s.owners[k * 8 + warp] & below)
+                    )
+                    s.union_ids[index] = expert
+        if tid == 0:
+            s.union_count[0] = total
+        rt.Memory.fence_proxy_async_shared()
+        rt.bar_sync(8, 256)
+        with rt.warp_leader(warp, 0):
+            rt.mbar_arrive(s.union_full)
+        if s.bid == 0:
+            if tid == 0:
+                p.Flags[sh.flag_union] = Uint32(total)
+            for i in range(tid, total, 256):
+                p.Flags[sh.flag_union + 1 + i] = Uint32(s.union_ids[i])

+    @cute.jit
+    def unit_count(self, s):
+        units = (s.union_count[0] + 1) * (SLICES * self.shape.ksplit)
+        return cdiv(units - s.bid + GRID_CTAS - 1, GRID_CTAS)

+    @cute.jit
+    def unit_fields(self, s, unit):
+        ks = self.shape.ksplit
+        slot = cdiv(unit, SLICES * ks)
+        slice_ = cmod(cdiv(unit, ks), SLICES)
+        part = cmod(unit, ks)
+        expert = Int32(LAYOUT.shared_slot)
+        if slot > 0:
+            expert = s.union_ids[slot - 1]
+        return slot, slice_, part, part * (K_BLOCKS // ks), expert

+    @cute.jit
+    def up_load(self, p, s, rows):
+        sm = self.Smem
+        ks = self.shape.ksplit
+        per = K_BLOCKS // ks
+        rt.mbar_wait(s.union_full, 0)
+        rt.Memory.fence_proxy_async_global()
+        units = self.unit_count(s)
+        tile = cdiv(rows + 7, 8) * 1024
+        maps = (self.up_map, self.shared_up_map)
+        sequence = Int32(0)
+        for local in range(units):
+            slot, slice_, part, first_kb, expert = self.unit_fields(
+                s, s.bid + local * GRID_CTAS
+            )
+            routed = Int32(slot > 0)
+            for i in range(per):
+                kb = first_kb + i
+                stage = cmod(sequence, sm.STAGES)
+                rt.mbar_wait(
+                    s.ring_empty + stage * 8, cmod(cdiv(sequence, sm.STAGES), 2) ^ 1
+                )
+                full = s.ring_full + stage * 8
+                dst = s.ring_addr + stage * self.shape.ring_stage
+                rt.mbar_expect_tx(full, A_STAGE + tile)
+                for half in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                    # Gate rows to TMEM lanes 0-63: rows 256.. of the routed w31.
+                    row = (routed ^ half) * SHARD + slice_ * SLICE
+                    desc, c0, c1, c3 = self.weight_box(
+                        maps, kb, row, expert, K_BLOCKS, 2 * SHARD
+                    )
+                    rt.AsyncCopy.tma_4d(
+                        dst + half * (A_STAGE // 2), desc, c0, c1, 0, c3, full, _HINT
+                    )
+                rt.bulk_g2s(
+                    dst + A_STAGE,
+                    rt.ga(p.Work, (self.shape.image + kb * self.RMAX * K_BLOCK) // 4),
+                    tile,
+                    full,
+                )
+                sequence = sequence + 1

+    @cute.jit
+    def up_mma(self, p, s):
+        sm = self.Smem
+        ks = self.shape.ksplit
+        per = K_BLOCKS // ks
+        q = self.RMAX
+        up_column = sm.DOWN_STAGES * 2 * q
+        rt.mbar_wait(s.union_full, 0)
+        units = self.unit_count(s)
+        sequence = Int32(0)
+        for local in range(units):
+            for i in range(per):
+                acc = cmod(sequence, 2)
+                stage = cmod(sequence, sm.STAGES)
+                rt.mbar_wait(s.acc_empty + acc * 8, cmod(cdiv(sequence, 2), 2) ^ 1)
+                rt.mbar_wait(
+                    s.ring_full + stage * 8, cmod(cdiv(sequence, sm.STAGES), 2)
+                )
+                rt.TensorCore.fence_after_thread_sync()
+                base = s.ring_addr + stage * self.shape.ring_stage
+                rt.Umma.mma_k128(
+                    rt.Umma.operand_low(base),
+                    rt.Umma.operand_low(base + A_STAGE),
+                    s.taddr + up_column + acc * q,
+                    q,
+                    0,
+                )
+                rt.TensorCore.tcgen05_commit(s.ring_empty + stage * 8)
+                rt.TensorCore.tcgen05_commit(s.acc_full + acc * 8)

+        rt.TensorCore.tcgen05_commit(s.up_done)

+    @cute.jit
+    def weight_scale(self, p, s, unit, entry):
+        per = K_BLOCKS // self.shape.ksplit
+        slot, slice_, part, first_kb, expert = self.unit_fields(s, unit)
+        half = cdiv(entry, per) ^ Int32(slot > 0)  # routed w31: up blocks first
+        scale_row = cdiv(half * SHARD + slice_ * SLICE, K_BLOCK)
+        word = scale_row * K_BLOCKS + first_kb + cmod(entry, per)
+        routed = Int64(expert) * LAYOUT.w13_scale_words + word
+        return self.block_scale(
+            slot, rt.ga(p.RoutedUpScales, routed), rt.ga(p.SharedScales, word)
+        )

+    @cute.jit
+    def block_scale(self, slot, routed, shared):

+        return rt.Convert.bits_f32(rt.Memory.ldg_nc_u32(address))

+    @cute.jit
+    def up_promote(self, p, s, units):
+        sm = self.Smem
+        sh = self.shape
+        q, ks = self.RMAX, sh.ksplit
+        per = K_BLOCKS // ks
+        entries = 2 * per
+        row = s.tid
+        half = cdiv(row, SLICE)
+        lane_base = (cmod(s.warp, 4) * 32) << 16
+        up_column = sm.DOWN_STAGES * 2 * q
+        upcoming = Float32(0.0)
+        if (row < entries) & (units > 0):
+            upcoming = self.weight_scale(p, s, s.bid, row)
+        sequence = Int32(0)
+        rt.mbar_wait(s.scales_full, 0)
+        for local in range(units):
+            unit = s.bid + local * GRID_CTAS
+            slot, slice_, part, first_kb, expert = self.unit_fields(s, unit)
+            if row < entries:
+                s.up_scales[cmod(local, 2) * entries + row] = upcoming
+            rt.bar_sync(9, 128)
+            if (row < entries) & (local + 1 < units):
+                upcoming = self.weight_scale(p, s, unit + GRID_CTAS, row)
+            total = rt.zeros(q)
+            for i in range(per):
+                acc = cmod(sequence, 2)
+                weight = s.up_scales[cmod(local, 2) * entries + half * per + i]
+                rt.mbar_wait(s.acc_full + acc * 8, cmod(cdiv(sequence, 2), 2))
+                rt.TensorCore.fence_after_thread_sync()
+                sums = rt.Umma.tmem_ld_columns(
+                    s.taddr + lane_base + up_column + acc * q, q
+                )
+                rt.Umma.wait_ld()
+                rt.TensorCore.fence_before_thread_sync()
+                if s.lane == 0:
+                    rt.mbar_arrive(s.acc_empty + acc * 8)
+                kb = first_kb + i
+                for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(q):
+                    total[t] = rt.fma(
+                        sums[t], rt.mul(weight, s.token_scales[kb * q + t]), total[t]
+                    )
+                sequence = sequence + 1
+            base = (
+                ((slot * ks + part) * 2 + half) * SHARD
+                + slice_ * SLICE
+                + cmod(row, SLICE)
+            ) * q
+            for chunk in cutlass.range_constexpr(q // ROW_CHUNK):
+                if chunk * ROW_CHUNK < self.active_rows(p):
+                    for quad in cutlass.range_constexpr(ROW_CHUNK // 4):
+                        rt.Memory.stg_u32x4(
+                            p.Work,
+                            sh.up_partials // 4 + base + chunk * ROW_CHUNK + 4 * quad,
+                            [
+                                rt.Convert.f32_bits(
+                                    total[chunk * ROW_CHUNK + 4 * quad + j]
+                                )
+                                for j in range(4)
+                            ],
+                        )
+            rt.bar_sync(SIGNAL_BARRIER, 128 + 32)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def up_signal(self, p, s):

+    @cute.jit
+    def route_weight(self, s, slot, token):

+        weight = Float32(0.0)
+        for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(TOP_K):

+    @cute.jit
+    def finalize_block(self, p, s, rows, slot, block, epoch):
+        sh = self.shape
+        q, ks = self.RMAX, sh.ksplit
+        t = s.tid - 128
+        warp4 = s.warp - 4
+        row = block * K_BLOCK + t
+        for chunk in range(cdiv(rows + FIN_TOKENS - 1, FIN_TOKENS)):
+            first = chunk * FIN_TOKENS
+            gate = [Float32(0.0)] * FIN_TOKENS
+            up = [Float32(0.0)] * FIN_TOKENS
+            for part in cutlass.range_constexpr(ks):
+                for half in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                    base = (((slot * ks + part) * 2 + half) * SHARD + row) * q + first
+                    for quad in cutlass.range_constexpr(FIN_TOKENS // 4):
+                        v = rt.Memory.ld_global_v4_f32(
+                            rt.ga(p.Work, sh.up_partials // 4 + base + 4 * quad)
+                        )
+                        for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                            if half == 0:
+                                gate[4 * quad + j] = rt.add(gate[4 * quad + j], v[j])
+                            else:
+                                up[4 * quad + j] = rt.add(up[4 * quad + j], v[j])
+            h = []
+            for token in cutlass.range_constexpr(FIN_TOKENS):
+                g = gate[token]
+                silu = rt.mul(
+                    g,
+                    rt.FastMath.rcp_rn(
+                        rt.add(1.0, cute.math.exp2(rt.mul(-g, LOG2E), fastmath=True))
+                    ),
+                )
+                h.append(rt.mul(silu, up[token]))
+            for token in cutlass.range_constexpr(FIN_TOKENS):
+                peak = rt.FastMath.abs_ftz(h[token])
+                for bit in cutlass.range_constexpr(5):
+                    peak = rt.FastMath.fmax(
+                        peak, cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(peak, 1 << bit)
+                    )
+                if s.lane == 0:
+                    s.fin_amax[warp4 * FIN_TOKENS + token] = peak
+            rt.bar_sync(10, 128)
+            if t < FIN_TOKENS:
+                peak = rt.FastMath.fmax(
+                    rt.FastMath.fmax(s.fin_amax[t], s.fin_amax[FIN_TOKENS + t]),
+                    rt.FastMath.fmax(
+                        s.fin_amax[2 * FIN_TOKENS + t], s.fin_amax[3 * FIN_TOKENS + t]
+                    ),
+                )
+                scale = rt.FastMath.div_rn(rt.FastMath.fmax(peak, QUANT_EPS), FP8_MAX)
+                s.fin_scale[t] = scale
+                if first + t < rows:
+                    p.Work[sh.token_scale // 4 + (slot * q + first + t) * 2 + block] = (
+                        rt.Convert.f32_bits(
+                            rt.mul(self.route_weight(s, slot, first + t), scale)
+                        )
+                    )
+            rt.bar_sync(10, 128)
+            piece = cdiv(t, 16)
+            for token in cutlass.range_constexpr(FIN_TOKENS):
+                value = rt.FastMath.div_rn(h[token], s.fin_scale[token])
+                second = cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(value, 1)
+                third = cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(value, 2)
+                fourth = cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(value, 3)
+                if cmod(t, 4) == 0:
+                    # 8-token tiles of the image: tile ``2 chunk + token / 8``
+                    byte = (
+                        sh.hq
+                        + (slot * 2 + block) * q * K_BLOCK
+                        + (chunk * (FIN_TOKENS // 8) + token // 8) * 1024
+                        + (token % 8) * 128
+                        + ((piece ^ (token % 8)) * 16)
+                        + cmod(t, 16)
+                    )
+                    p.Work[cdiv(byte, 4)] = rt.Convert.e4m3x4(
+                        value, second, third, fourth
+                    )
+            rt.bar_sync(10, 128)
+        rt.Memory.fence_proxy_async_global()
+        rt.bar_sync(10, 128)
+        if t == 0:
+            rt.Memory.fence_release_gpu()
+            rt.Memory.st_relaxed_sys(
+                rt.ga(p.Flags, sh.flag_ready + 2 * slot + block), epoch + 1
+            )
+

+                )

+                    dst + kb * A_STAGE, desc, c0, c1, 0, c3, full, _HINT
+                )
+            waiting = Int32(1)
+            while waiting != 0:
+                first = rt.Memory.ld_relaxed_gpu(
+                    rt.ga(p.Flags, sh.flag_ready + 2 * slot)
+                )
+                second = rt.Memory.ld_relaxed_gpu(
+                    rt.ga(p.Flags, sh.flag_ready + 2 * slot + 1)
+                )
+                if (first >= epoch + 1) & (second >= epoch + 1):
+                    waiting = Int32(0)
+            rt.Memory.fence_acquire_gpu()
+            rt.Memory.fence_proxy_async_global()
+            for kb in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                rt.bulk_g2s(
+                    dst + 2 * A_STAGE + kb * q * K_BLOCK,
+                    rt.ga(p.Work, (sh.hq + (slot * 2 + kb) * q * K_BLOCK) // 4),
+                    tile,
+                    full,
+                )
+            rt.bulk_g2s(
+                dst + sh.down_scales,
+                rt.ga(p.Work, (sh.token_scale + slot * q * 8) // 4),
+                scale_bytes,
+                full,
+            )
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def down_mma(self, p, s):
+        sm, sh = self.Smem, self.shape
+        q = self.RMAX
+        _, _, count = self.down_slots(s)
+        for j in range(count):
+            stage = cmod(j, sm.DOWN_STAGES)
+            phase = cmod(cdiv(j, sm.DOWN_STAGES), 2)
+            rt.mbar_wait(s.down_full + stage * 8, phase)
+            rt.mbar_wait(s.down_free + stage * 8, phase ^ 1)
+            rt.TensorCore.fence_after_thread_sync()
+            base = s.ring_addr + stage * sh.down_stage
+            for kb in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                rt.Umma.mma_k128(
+                    rt.Umma.operand_low(base + kb * A_STAGE),
+                    rt.Umma.operand_low(base + 2 * A_STAGE + kb * q * K_BLOCK),
+                    s.taddr + (stage * 2 + kb) * q,
+                    q,
+                    0,
+                )
+            rt.TensorCore.tcgen05_commit(s.down_ready + stage * 8)

+    @cute.jit
+    def down_scale(self, p, s, slot, block, kb):
+        word = block * 2 + kb
+        routed = Int64(self.slot_expert(s, slot)) * LAYOUT.w2_scale_words + word
+        shared = LAYOUT.w13_scale_words + word
+        return self.block_scale(
+            slot, rt.ga(p.RoutedDownScales, routed), rt.ga(p.SharedScales, shared)
+        )
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def down_promote(self, p, s, rows):
+        sm, sh = self.Smem, self.shape
+        q = self.RMAX
+        chunk = 32 if q % 32 == 0 else 16
+        group, block, count = self.down_slots(s)
+        row = s.tid
+        lane_base = (cmod(s.warp, 4) * 32) << 16
+        total = rt.zeros(q)
+        scale0, scale1 = Float32(0.0), Float32(0.0)
+        if count > 0:
+            scale0 = self.down_scale(p, s, group, block, 0)
+            scale1 = self.down_scale(p, s, group, block, 1)
+        for j in range(count):
+            stage = cmod(j, sm.DOWN_STAGES)
+            rt.mbar_wait(s.down_ready + stage * 8, cmod(cdiv(j, sm.DOWN_STAGES), 2))
+            rt.TensorCore.fence_after_thread_sync()
+            tokens = s.ring_addr + stage * sh.down_stage + sh.down_scales
+            for c in cutlass.range_constexpr(q // chunk):
+                column = s.taddr + lane_base + stage * 2 * q + c * chunk
+                first = rt.Umma.tmem_ld_columns(column, chunk)
+                second = rt.Umma.tmem_ld_columns(column + q, chunk)
+                rt.Umma.wait_ld()
+                for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(chunk):
+                    index = c * chunk + t
+                    total[index] = rt.fma(
+                        first[t],
+                        rt.mul(scale0, rt.Memory.lds(tokens + index * 8)),
+                        total[index],
+                    )
+                    total[index] = rt.fma(
+                        second[t],
+                        rt.mul(scale1, rt.Memory.lds(tokens + index * 8 + 4)),
+                        total[index],
+                    )
+            rt.TensorCore.fence_before_thread_sync()
+            cute.arch.sync_warp()
+            if s.lane == 0:
+                rt.mbar_arrive(s.down_free + stage * 8)
+            if j + 1 < count:
+                scale0 = self.down_scale(p, s, group + DOWN_GROUPS * (j + 1), block, 0)
+                scale1 = self.down_scale(p, s, group + DOWN_GROUPS * (j + 1), block, 1)
+        if s.bid < DOWN_CTAS:
+            for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(q):
+                if t < rows:
+                    p.Work[
+                        sh.down_partials // 4
+                        + (group * q + t) * HIDDEN
+                        + block * DOWN_ROW_BLOCK
+                        + row
+                    ] = rt.Convert.f32_bits(total[t])
+            rt.bar_sync(9, 128)
+            if row == 0:
+                rt.Memory.fence_release_gpu()
+                rt.Memory.atomic_add_u32(p.Flags, sh.flag_down + block, 1)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def owner(self, p, s, rows, epoch):
+        sh = self.shape
+        first = s.bid * OWNER_ROWS
+        if s.warp == 0:
+            target = Uint32(DOWN_GROUPS) * (epoch + 1)
+            waiting = Int32(1)
+            while waiting != 0:
+                low = rt.Memory.ld_relaxed_gpu(
+                    rt.ga(p.Flags, sh.flag_down + cdiv(first, DOWN_ROW_BLOCK))
+                )
+                high = rt.Memory.ld_relaxed_gpu(
+                    rt.ga(
+                        p.Flags,
+                        sh.flag_down + cdiv(first + OWNER_ROWS - 1, DOWN_ROW_BLOCK),
+                    )
+                )
+                waiting = Int32(
+                    cute.arch.vote_all_sync((low >= target) & (high >= target)) == 0
+                )
+            rt.Memory.fence_acquire_gpu()
+        rt.bar_sync(8, 256)
+        for index in range(s.tid, rows * OWNER_ROWS, 256):
+            token, column = cdiv(index, OWNER_ROWS), cmod(index, OWNER_ROWS)
+            total = Float32(0.0)
+            for g in cutlass.range_constexpr(DOWN_GROUPS):
+                part = rt.Convert.bits_f32(
+                    rt.Memory.ld_cg_b32(
+                        rt.ga(
+                            p.Work,
+                            sh.down_partials // 4
+                            + (g * self.RMAX + token) * HIDDEN
+                            + first
+                            + column,
+                        )
+                    )
+                )
+                total = part if g == 0 else rt.add(total, part)
+            value = total.to(BFloat16)
+            s.local_o[index] = value
+            p.LocalO[token * HIDDEN + first + column] = value
+        rt.bar_sync(8, 256)
+        self.exchange_slice(p, s, rows, epoch)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def exchange_slice(self, p, s, rows, epoch):
+        self.exchange.push_peers(
+            p, s.local_o_words, epoch, s.bid, s.tid, s.warp, s.lane
+        )
+        if cutlass.const_expr(self.SEAM):  # noqa: SIM102 (nested: const_expr)
+            if s.warp == 7:  # the own partial goes to the own slot
+                peer = rt.Memory.select_peer(p.peer_rank, p.peer_bases)
+                for group in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.exchange.groups):
+                    self.exchange.push(
+                        s.local_o_words,
+                        epoch,
+                        s.bid,
+                        s.lane,
+                        peer,
+                        self.exchange.OWN,
+                        group,
+                    )
+        for turn in cutlass.range_constexpr(-(-self.exchange.groups // 8)):
+            group = s.warp + 8 * turn
+            if group * rt.SliceExchange.GROUP_TOKENS < rows:
+                self.exchange.combine(
+                    p,
+                    p.X,
+                    s.lane,
+                    s.bid,
+                    epoch,
+                    None if self.SEAM else s.local_o_words,
+                    group=group,
+                    live=rows,
+                )
+
+

+    """The row-tier MoE of a seam layer: also writes ``XG = Final x GammaNext``."""
+
+    SEAM = True

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Host-visible state sizes for the fixed four- and eight-row W8A16 MoE."""
+
+
+class Flag:
+    """``Flags`` (u32 words)."""
+
+    WORDS = 14952
+    ACT = 144
+    PLANES = 288
+    LOCAL_O = 432
+    DONE = 576
+    ROUND = 11601
+    PAD_FIRST = 11732
+    PAGE = 1024
+    PAD_SHARED = 128
+    PAD_ROUND = 256
+    #: The words after the three pages: each SM's mirror copy (0 or 1).
+    SM_DOMAIN = PAD_FIRST + 3 * PAGE
+    #: Words from a mirrored word to its copy in the other locality domain.
+    MIRROR = 1 << 21
+
+
+class Q8Flag(Flag):
+    """Eight-row logit parity pages with the same mirrored counter prefix."""
+
+    PAGE = 2048
+    SM_DOMAIN = Flag.PAD_FIRST + 3 * PAGE
+    WORDS = SM_DOMAIN + 148
+
+
+class Q8Shape:
+    """Fixed eight-row capacity and communication sizes shared by host and kernel."""
+
+    ROWS = 8
+    ROUNDS = 8
+    MAX_UNION = ROWS * 8
+    PLANES = MAX_UNION + 1
+    RING_SLOTS = 3
+    MAILBOX_BYTES = 7 * 2 * 128 * ROWS * 128
+    SEAM_MAILBOX_BYTES = 8 * 2 * 128 * ROWS * 128
+
+
+def flag_layout(rows: int = 4) -> type[Flag]:
+    """Return the fixed-row flag layout used by kernel and locality allocation."""
+    if rows == 4:
+        return Flag
+    if rows == Q8Shape.ROWS:
+        return Q8Flag
+    raise ValueError(f"W8A16 MoE supports 4 or 8 rows, got {rows}")

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Decode prologue: gather each query token's embedding row and RoPE row."""
+
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+from cutlass import BFloat16, Float32, Int32, Int64
+
+from . import _rt as rt
+from .row_table import RowTableLayout
+
+const_expr = cutlass.const_expr
+
+HIDDEN = rt.Core.HIDDEN
+ROPE_COLS = 64
+
+
+@rt.record
+class PrologueQ4Params:
+    """Kernel parameters of ``prologue_q4``."""
+
+    TokenIds: cute.Pointer = rt.ptr("int32", align=4)
+    Position: cute.Pointer = rt.ptr("int32", align=4)
+    Embedding: cute.Pointer = rt.ptr("bfloat16")
+    RopeTable: cute.Pointer = rt.ptr("float32")
+    Hidden: cute.Pointer = rt.ptr("bfloat16")
+    Freq: cute.Pointer = rt.ptr("float32")
+    rope_capacity: Int32
+    RowTable: cute.Pointer = rt.ptr("int32", align=4)
+
+
+@rt.record
+class PrologueVllmParams:
+    """Kernel parameters of ``prologue_vllm{,_q4}``."""
+
+    TokenIds: cute.Pointer = rt.ptr("int32", align=4)
+    Position: cute.Pointer = rt.ptr("int32", align=4)
+    RopeTable: cute.Pointer = rt.ptr("float32")
+    Hidden: cute.Pointer = rt.ptr("bfloat16")
+    Freq: cute.Pointer = rt.ptr("float32")
+    rope_capacity: Int32
+    RowTable: cute.Pointer = rt.ptr("int32", align=4)
+    EmbeddingShard0: Int64
+    EmbeddingShard1: Int64
+    EmbeddingShard2: Int64
+    EmbeddingShard3: Int64
+    EmbeddingShard4: Int64
+    EmbeddingShard5: Int64
+    EmbeddingShard6: Int64
+    EmbeddingShard7: Int64
+
+    @property
+    def shards(self) -> list:
+        return [getattr(self, f"EmbeddingShard{i}") for i in range(8)]
+
+
+class PrologueKernel(rt.DecodeKernel):
+    """One 256-thread CTA per row of the build's capacity ``ROWS``; the row table
+    (``row_table.py``) says which rows are live.
+    """
+
+    BLOCK = 256
+    MIN_BLOCKS_PER_MP = None
+    #: Row capacity (Rmax) and request capacity (Bmax) of the build.
+    ROWS = 4
+    REQUESTS = 1
+    PACKED = False
+
+    @property
+    def GRID(self) -> int:  # type: ignore[override]
+        return self.ROWS
+
+    @property
+    def layout(self) -> RowTableLayout:
+        return RowTableLayout(self.ROWS, self.REQUESTS)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def prologue(self, p):
+        tid, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+        query, _, _ = cute.arch.block_idx()
+        rt.Sync.pdl_prologue()
+        return rt.ThreadIds(tid, query, None, None), None
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def run(self, p, s, ids: rt.ThreadIds):
+        tid, query = ids.tid, ids.bid
+        layout = self.layout
+        table = cute.make_tensor(
+            p.RowTable,
+            cute.make_layout(layout.table_words if self.PACKED else layout.words),
+        )
+        if query < table[0]:
+            request = table[layout.row_request_word(query)]
+            first = table[layout.first_row_word(request)]
+            token = cute.make_tensor(p.TokenIds, cute.make_layout(self.ROWS))[query]
+            words = cute.make_tensor(p.Position, cute.make_layout(2 * self.ROWS))
+            start = words[2 * first]
+            position = start + query - first
+            if (
+                (token < 0)
+                | (token >= rt.Core.VOCAB)
+                | (start < 0)
+                | (position >= p.rope_capacity)
+            ):
+                rt.Sync.trap()
+            self.copy_row(p, tid, query, token, position)
+            if (tid == 0) & (query == first):
+                table[layout.context_word(request)] = start + 1
+            if const_expr(self.PACKED):  # noqa: SIM102
+                if (tid == 0) & (query == 0):
+                    table[layout.step_word] = table[layout.step_word] + 1
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def copy_row(self, p, tid, query, token, position):
+        embedding_row = self.embedding_row(p, token)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+        hidden = cute.make_tensor(
+            p.Hidden,
+            cute.make_layout((self.ROWS, 3, 256, 8), stride=(HIDDEN, 2048, 8, 1)),
+        )
+        vals = [rt.Convert.ld_bf16x8_f32(embedding_row[j, tid, None]) for j in range(3)]
+        for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(3):
+            rt.Convert.st_f32_bf16x8(vals[j], hidden[query, j, tid, None])
+        if tid < 16:
+            rope = cute.make_tensor(
+                p.RopeTable,
+                cute.make_layout((1 << 24, 16, 4), stride=(ROPE_COLS, 4, 1)),
+            )
+            freq = cute.make_tensor(
+                p.Freq, cute.make_layout((self.ROWS, 16, 4), stride=(ROPE_COLS, 4, 1))
+            )
+            atom = cute.make_copy_atom(
+                cute.nvgpu.CopyUniversalOp(), Float32, num_bits_per_copy=128
+            )
+            v = cute.make_rmem_tensor(4, Float32)
+            cute.copy(atom, rope[position, tid, None], v)
+            cute.copy(atom, v, freq[query, tid, None])
+
+
+class PrologueQ4(PrologueKernel):
+    """One contiguous embedding table."""
+
+    Params = PrologueQ4Params
+
+    def embedding_row(self, p: PrologueQ4Params, token):
+        table = cute.make_tensor(
+            p.Embedding,
+            cute.make_layout((rt.Core.VOCAB, 3, 256, 8), stride=(HIDDEN, 2048, 8, 1)),
+        )
+        return table[token, None, None, None]
+
+
+class PrologueVllm(PrologueKernel):
+    """The vLLM vocab-parallel table: eight shards at eight peer base addresses."""
+
+    Params = PrologueVllmParams
+
+    def embedding_row(self, p: PrologueVllmParams, token):
+        owner = token // rt.Core.SHARD_ROWS
+        local = token - owner * rt.Core.SHARD_ROWS
+        base = rt.Memory.select_peer(owner, p.shards)
+        row_ptr = rt.Memory.gmem_ptr(BFloat16, base + Int64(local) * (HIDDEN * 2))
+        return cute.make_tensor(
+            row_ptr, cute.make_layout((3, 256, 8), stride=(2048, 8, 1))
+        )

+
+def _row_tier_entries() -> dict[str, CuteEntry]:
+    entries: dict[str, CuteEntry] = {}
+    for rmax in ROW_TIERS:
+        knobs = (("ROWS", rmax), ("REQUESTS", rmax // (TIER_DRAFTS + 1)))
+        entries[f"prologue_vllm_r{rmax}"] = CuteEntry("prologue", "PrologueVllm", knobs)
+        entries[f"prologue_r{rmax}"] = CuteEntry("prologue", "PrologueQ4", knobs)
+        # The dense FFN's mailbox holds 7 peers x 2 parities x 128 slices x rmax rows.
+        entries[f"dense_ffn_r{rmax}_vllm"] = CuteEntry(
+            "dense_ffn",
+            "DenseFfn",
+            (("ROWS", rmax),),
+            host={"kMailboxBytes": 229376 * rmax, "kFlagWords": 3840},
+        )
+        groups = rmax // 4
+        for role, cls, mailbox in _WORKER_ROLES:
+            entries[f"mla_worker_r{rmax}_{role}_paged_vlin"] = _worker_entry(
+                rmax, role, cls, mailbox, knobs
+            )
+        splits = ["serve"] + (["gserve"] if rmax in LONE_TIERS else [])
+        blocks = {
+            name: -(-_SELECTOR[name] // 4) * 4 * groups for name in _SELECTOR_BLOCKS
+        }
+        for split in splits:
+            for rank in range(WIDE_SELECTOR_RANKS):
+                extra: tuple[tuple[str, int | bool], ...] = (
+                    ("SHARDS", 1),
+                    ("SERVE", WIDE_SELECTOR_RANKS),
+                    ("RANK", rank),
+                )
+                if split == "gserve":
+                    extra += (("GROUP_SERVE", True),)
+                selector = _sel(0, knobs=knobs + extra)
+                name = (
+                    f"mla_selector_r{rmax}_{split}{WIDE_SELECTOR_RANKS}r{rank}"
+                    "_paged_vlin"
+                )
+                entries[name] = CuteEntry(
+                    selector.module,
+                    selector.cls,
+                    selector.constants,
+                    _SELECTOR | blocks,
+                )
+    return entries
+
+
+ENTRIES.update(_row_tier_entries())
+
+PACKED_TIERS = (8, 16)
+
+
+def _packed_entries() -> dict[str, CuteEntry]:
+    entries: dict[str, CuteEntry] = {}
+    for rmax in PACKED_TIERS:
+        knobs = (("ROWS", rmax), ("REQUESTS", PACKED_SLOTS[rmax]))
+        # vLLM's embedding shards (served) and a replicated table.
+        for name, cls in (
+            ("prologue_vllm", "PrologueVllm"),
+            ("prologue", "PrologueQ4"),
+        ):
+            entries[f"{name}_r{rmax}p"] = CuteEntry(
+                "prologue", cls, knobs + (("PACKED", True),)
+            )
+        for role, cls, mailbox in _WORKER_ROLES:
+            entries[f"mla_worker_r{rmax}p_{role}_paged_vlin"] = _worker_entry(
+                rmax, role, cls, mailbox, knobs, packed=True
+            )
+        slots = PACKED_SLOTS[rmax]
+        blocks = {
+            name: -(-_SELECTOR[name] // 4) * 4 * max(slots, rmax // 4)
+            for name in _SELECTOR_BLOCKS
+        }
+        for rank in range(WIDE_SELECTOR_RANKS):
+            extra = (
+                ("SHARDS", 1),
+                ("SERVE", WIDE_SELECTOR_RANKS),
+                ("RANK", rank),
+                ("SEGMENTS", True),
+                ("SEGMENT_SLOTS", slots),
+            )
+            selector = _sel(0, knobs=knobs + extra)
+            name = f"mla_selector_r{rmax}p_serve{WIDE_SELECTOR_RANKS}r{rank}_paged_vlin"
+            entries[name] = CuteEntry(
+                selector.module, selector.cls, selector.constants, _SELECTOR | blocks
+            )
+    return entries
+
+
+ENTRIES.update(_packed_entries())
+
+
+def _moe_tier(rmax: int, seam: bool = False) -> CuteEntry:
+    shape = TierShape(rmax, seam)
+    return CuteEntry(
+        "fused_moe_w8a8",
+        "FusedMoeW8A8Seam" if seam else "FusedMoeW8A8",
+        (("RMAX", rmax),),
+        host={
+            "kMailboxBytes": shape.mailbox_bytes,
+            "kFlagWords": shape.flag_words,
+            "kWorkBytes": shape.work_bytes,
+            "kRowTableWords": 2 + 3 * rmax,
+        },
+    )
+
+
+ENTRIES.update({f"fused_moe_r{r}_ckpt_shared": _moe_tier(r) for r in TIERS})
+ENTRIES.update({f"fused_moe_r{r}_seam_ckpt_shared": _moe_tier(r, True) for r in TIERS})
+
+
+def kernel_class(name: str) -> type:
+    """Return entry ``name``'s kernel class."""
+    entry = ENTRIES[name]
+    return getattr(importlib.import_module(f"{__package__}.{entry.module}"), entry.cls)
+
+
+def kernel(name: str, arch: str = "sm_100a") -> object:
+    """Return entry ``name``'s configured kernel object (an ``rt.DecodeKernel``)."""
+    cls = kernel_class(name)
+    knobs = dict(ENTRIES[name].constants)
+    if hasattr(cls, "EXPLICIT_SMEM_BASE"):
+        knobs["EXPLICIT_SMEM_BASE"] = arch == "sm_100a"
+    return cls(**knobs)
+
+
+def _arguments(cls: type) -> list[tuple[str, dict, type]]:
+    records = getattr(cls, "RECORDS", None) or (cls.Params,)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    fields = [
+        (f.name, dict(f.metadata), f.type)
+        for r in records
+        for f in dataclasses.fields(r)
+    ]
+    return fields + [(n, {}, t) for n, t in cls.HOST_ARGS]  # type: ignore[attr-defined, return-value]
+
+
+def arguments(name: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
+    """Return entry ``name``'s host-wrapper argument names, in order (the stream
+    follows).
+    """
+    return tuple(n for n, _, _ in _arguments(kernel_class(name)))
+
+
+def bind(name: str, values: Sequence[int | None]) -> tuple:
+    """Return the host wrapper's typed arguments for ``values`` (addresses, None for
+    null, scalars).
+    """
+    import cutlass
+    import cutlass.cute as cute
+
+    specs = _arguments(kernel_class(name))
+    if len(values) != len(specs):
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"{name}: {len(values)} arguments for {[n for n, _, _ in specs]}"
+        )
+    bound = []
+    for (_, meta, type_), value in zip(specs, values):
+        if "dtype" in meta:
+            dtype = getattr(cutlass, ELEMENT_TYPES[meta["dtype"]])
+            gmem = cute.AddressSpace.gmem
+            bound.append(
+                cute.runtime.make_ptr(
+                    dtype, value or 0, gmem, assumed_align=meta["align"]
+                )
+            )
+        else:
+            bound.append(type_(value))
+    return tuple(bound)
+
+
+def example_arguments(name: str) -> tuple:
+    """Return typed host-wrapper arguments to compile entry ``name`` with (the stream
+    follows).
+    """
+    specs = _arguments(kernel_class(name))
+    return bind(
+        name, [EXAMPLE_ADDRESS if "dtype" in meta else 0 for _, meta, _ in specs]
+    )
+
+
+@functools.cache
+def _source_digest() -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(importlib.metadata.version("nvidia-cutlass-dsl").encode())
+    for path in sorted(PACKAGE_DIR.rglob("*.py")):
+        digest.update(path.name.encode() + b"\0" + path.read_bytes())
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+@functools.cache
+def compiled(name: str, arch: str) -> JitCompiledFunction:
+    """Return entry ``name``'s host wrapper for ``arch``: from the object cache, else
+    compiled and cached.
+    """
+    import cutlass.cute as cute
+    from cuda.bindings.driver import CUstream
+    from cutlass.runtime import load_module
+
+    import vllm.envs as envs
+
+    constants = repr(ENTRIES[name].constants)
+    key = f"{name}/{arch}/{constants}/{_source_digest()}"
+    key = hashlib.sha256(key.encode()).hexdigest()[:32]
+    path = Path(envs.VLLM_CACHE_ROOT) / "glm53_kernels" / f"{name}.{arch}.{key}.o"
+    if path.is_file():
+        return getattr(load_module(str(path)), name)
+    start = time.perf_counter()
+    function = cute.compile(
+        kernel(name, arch).launch,  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+        *example_arguments(name),
+        CUstream(0),
+        options=f"--gpu-arch {arch}",
+    )
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    temporary = path.with_suffix(f".{os.getpid()}.tmp")
+    temporary.write_bytes(function.dump_to_object(name))
+    temporary.replace(path)
+    logger.info(
+        "GLM-5.3: compiled CuTe kernel %s for %s in %.2f s.",
+        name,
+        arch,
+        time.perf_counter() - start,
+    )
+    return function
+
+
+@functools.cache
+def executor(name: str, device_index: int) -> JitExecutor:
+    """Return entry ``name`` compiled for device ``device_index`` and bound to it; call
+    it with :func:`bind`'s arguments and a ``CUstream`` (capturable into a CUDA
+    graph).
+    """
+    major, minor = torch.cuda.get_device_capability(device_index)
+    return compiled(name, f"sm_{major}{minor}a").to(device_index)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The row table: how a row-tier decode kernel learns which rows of a step are live."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Sequence
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+#: Header words before the row to request map.
+HEADER_WORDS = 2
+#: Word indices of the header.
+ROWS_WORD = 0
+REQUESTS_WORD = 1
+#: Rows of one worker group and of one selector segment.
+SEGMENT_ROWS = 4
+SEGMENT_SLACK = 3
+#: Selector slots of each packed tier, also its request capacity (a request takes at
+#: least one slot; on tier 16 a selector rank serves requests ``r`` and ``r + 8``).
+PACKED_SLOTS = {8: 8, 16: 16}
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class RowTableLayout:
+    """Word offsets of the row table of one tier (``rmax`` rows, ``bmax`` requests)."""
+
+    rmax: int
+    bmax: int
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if self.rmax < 1 or not 1 <= self.bmax <= self.rmax:
+            raise ValueError(f"row table of {self.rmax} rows, {self.bmax} requests")
+
+    @property
+    def words(self) -> int:
+        return self.block_row_word(self.bmax - 1) + 1
+
+    @property
+    def bytes(self) -> int:
+        return 4 * self.words
+
+    @property
+    def step_word(self) -> int:
+        return self.words
+
+    @property
+    def table_words(self) -> int:
+        return self.words + 1
+
+    def row_request_word(self, row: int) -> int:
+        return HEADER_WORDS + row
+
+    def first_row_word(self, request: int) -> int:
+        return HEADER_WORDS + self.rmax + request
+
+    def context_word(self, request: int) -> int:
+        return HEADER_WORDS + self.rmax + self.bmax + request
+
+    def block_row_word(self, request: int) -> int:
+        return HEADER_WORDS + self.rmax + 2 * self.bmax + request
+
+
+def header(
+    layout: RowTableLayout,
+    rows_per_request: Sequence[int],
+    block_rows: Sequence[int] | None = None,
+) -> list[int]:
+    """Return the table a step whose requests own the given row counts starts with:
+    everything the host knows, with the context words 0.
+    """
+    requests = len(rows_per_request)
+    rows = sum(rows_per_request)
+    if not 1 <= requests <= layout.bmax or not 1 <= rows <= layout.rmax:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"{requests} requests / {rows} rows do not fit the tier "
+            f"({layout.bmax} / {layout.rmax})"
+        )
+    if min(rows_per_request) < 1:
+        raise ValueError("every live request owns at least one row")
+    words = [0] * layout.words
+    words[ROWS_WORD], words[REQUESTS_WORD] = rows, requests
+    block_rows = range(requests) if block_rows is None else block_rows
+    if len(block_rows) != requests:
+        raise ValueError("one block-table row per request")
+    first = 0
+    for request, count in enumerate(rows_per_request):
+        words[layout.first_row_word(request)] = first
+        words[layout.block_row_word(request)] = block_rows[request]
+        for row in range(first, first + count):
+            words[layout.row_request_word(row)] = request
+        first += count
+    return words
+
+
+def segments_per_request(rows_per_request: int) -> int:
+    """Return how many selector segments (``SEGMENT_ROWS`` rows each, the last one
+    shorter) a request of ``rows_per_request`` rows has.
+    """
+    return -(-rows_per_request // SEGMENT_ROWS)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Segment:
+    """One selector slot of a packed step: ``rows`` consecutive rows of ``request``,
+    starting ``offset`` rows into it.
+    """
+
+    request: int
+    sub: int
+    offset: int
+    rows: int
+
+
+def segment(slot: int, rows_per_request: int) -> Segment:
+    """Return the segment selector slot ``slot`` serves in a uniform step: request
+    ``slot // m`` and its ``slot % m``-th group of four rows (``m`` = segments per
+    request).
+    """
+    count = segments_per_request(rows_per_request)
+    request, sub = divmod(slot, count)
+    offset = SEGMENT_ROWS * sub
+    return Segment(request, sub, offset, min(SEGMENT_ROWS, rows_per_request - offset))

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Counts, workspace layout and ``Flags`` map of the GLM-5.3 W8A8 MoE row tiers."""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+GRID_CTAS = 148
+LOW_CTAS = 128
+EXPERTS = 256
+TOP_K = 8
+HIDDEN = 6144
+SHARD = 256
+K_BLOCK = 128
+K_BLOCKS = HIDDEN // K_BLOCK
+SLICE = 64
+SLICES = SHARD // SLICE
+TILE_M = 2 * SLICE
+A_STAGE = TILE_M * K_BLOCK
+DOWN_GROUPS = 3
+DOWN_ROW_BLOCK = 128
+DOWN_CTAS = (HIDDEN // DOWN_ROW_BLOCK) * DOWN_GROUPS
+OWNER_ROWS = 48
+TIER_KSPLIT = {16: 2}
+TIERS = tuple(TIER_KSPLIT)
+
+
+def _align(offset: int, alignment: int = 1024) -> int:
+    return -(-offset // alignment) * alignment
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class TierShape:
+    """Counts and offsets of the tier with row capacity ``rmax`` (host and kernel)."""
+
+    rmax: int
+    seam: bool = False
+
+    @property
+    def ksplit(self) -> int:
+        return TIER_KSPLIT[self.rmax]
+
+    @property
+    def pairs(self) -> int:
+        return TOP_K * self.rmax
+
+    @property
+    def max_union(self) -> int:
+        return min(self.pairs, EXPERTS)
+
+    @property
+    def slots(self) -> int:
+        return 1 + self.max_union
+
+    @property
+    def up_partials(self) -> int:
+        return 0
+
+    @property
+    def hq(self) -> int:
+        return _align(self.slots * self.ksplit * 2 * SHARD * self.rmax * 4)
+
+    @property
+    def token_scale(self) -> int:
+        return _align(self.hq + self.slots * self.rmax * SHARD)
+
+    @property
+    def down_partials(self) -> int:
+        return _align(self.token_scale + self.slots * self.rmax * 2 * 4)
+
+    @property
+    def image(self) -> int:
+        return _align(self.down_partials + DOWN_GROUPS * self.rmax * HIDDEN * 4)
+
+    @property
+    def image_scales(self) -> int:
+        return _align(self.image + self.rmax * HIDDEN)
+
+    @property
+    def scores(self) -> int:
+        return _align(self.image_scales + K_BLOCKS * self.rmax * 4)
+
+    @property
+    def corrected(self) -> int:
+        return self.scores + self.rmax * EXPERTS * 4
+
+    @property
+    def work_bytes(self) -> int:
+        return _align(self.corrected + self.rmax * EXPERTS * 4)
+
+    @property
+    def flag_router(self) -> int:
+        return 0
+
+    @property
+    def flag_image(self) -> int:
+        return GRID_CTAS
+
+    @property
+    def flag_counter(self) -> int:
+        return 2 * GRID_CTAS
+
+    @property
+    def flag_ready(self) -> int:
+        return self.flag_counter + 2 * self.slots
+
+    @property
+    def flag_down(self) -> int:
+        return self.flag_ready + 2 * self.slots
+
+    @property
+    def flag_union(self) -> int:
+        return _align(self.flag_down + HIDDEN // DOWN_ROW_BLOCK, 4)
+
+    @property
+    def flag_words(self) -> int:
+        return _align(self.flag_union + 4 + self.slots, 128)
+
+    @property
+    def mailbox_bytes(self) -> int:
+        return (8 if self.seam else 7) * 2 * 128 * self.rmax * 128
+
+    @property
+    def ring_stage(self) -> int:
+        return A_STAGE + self.rmax * K_BLOCK
+
+    @property
+    def down_scales(self) -> int:
+        return 2 * A_STAGE + 2 * self.rmax * K_BLOCK
+
+    @property
+    def down_stage(self) -> int:
+        return _align(2 * A_STAGE + 2 * self.rmax * K_BLOCK + self.rmax * 2 * 4, 1024)
